label: At D1 after a rewarded a1 trial, strongest if rare (S2), scaled by belief S1 good.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * (in_rew == 1) * (prev_action != 2) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 r") ;; (phase == D1) * (in_rew == 1) * belief_lo
terms: (phase == D1) * (in_rew == 1) * (prev_action != 2) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 r") ;; (phase == D1) * (in_rew == 1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (in_rew == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (in_rew == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (in_rew == 1) * (tv("action", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (in_rew == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 2)
explanation: Active only at D1 (zero at GO and D2). Its magnitude is driven by the reward input: after unrewarded trials it is near zero, and after rewarded a2 trials it is mostly low. It is high after a rewarded a1 trial, highest after a1 -> S2 rewarded (rare), and higher when the ideal observer believes S1 is good (belief_lo, gated by reward). The free fit adds the trial before: if that trial was also rewarded, activation is lower (about -0.57); if it was an a1 choice or reached S2, activation is higher. That lifts dev R^2 from 0.27 to 0.39. Rewarded a2 trials sometimes still give high activation after a run of a1 rewards, which the short form misses. No future variables are used.
